local self=require('openmw.self')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died viewing original Stool')
 print('StoolView alive')
 local mode=camera.getMode();print('StoolViewMode first='..tostring(mode==camera.MODE.FirstPerson)..' third='..tostring(mode==camera.MODE.ThirdPerson))
 local yaw=-1.7831851243972778+.8
 local target=self.position+util.vector3(math.sin(yaw)*10000,math.cos(yaw)*10000,100-math.tan(.2)*10000)
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target)
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('StoolView aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(ax)<.015 and math.abs(ay)<.015 then print('StoolView ready') end
end}}}}
